title: [P2] Naming drift → silent no-ops (spec key ≠ consumed key)
body:
Part of the metadata liveness audit umbrella #1878 (P2 — spec hygiene, cluster #3).

## Problem
**Naming drift**: the spec key ≠ the key actually consumed, so the authored property is a silent no-op. Each pair below needs the spec and consumer reconciled to a single name (and an alias/migration where authors already use the wrong one).

## Checklist
- [ ] field: `maxLength` / `minLength` / `referenceFilters` / `maxRating`
- [ ] page: `type` → `pageType`; `label` → `title`; `visibility`
- [ ] dashboard: `title` vs `label`
- [ ] app: renderer reads `accentColor` / `badgeVariant` / `separator` — **not declared in spec** (see also the inverse-drift issue)
- [ ] action: `disabled` → `enabled` (see also the P0 action issue for the CEL form)
- [ ] flow: `http` vs deprecated `http_request` (Studio authors the alias)
- [ ] skill: `requiredPermissions` vs `permissions`
- [ ] agent: `knowledge.topics` → `knowledge.sources`
- [ ] webhook: `object` → `object_name`; `isActive` → `active`

## Evidence
- `docs/audits/README.md` cluster #3, plus the per-type reports for each item above.
